## recipe-92 — Refined Storm Roast

**Source:** public; Cooking level 3; tier 2; Common; DC 11; 1 active hours; 5 serving(s). Standard batch reference 69 gp.

**Preserved effect:** After a 10-minute meal, gain 4 temporary hit points and resistance to lightning damage for 1 hour. A creature can benefit from one feast at a time.

**Operational effect:** After completing and accepting this feast, offer 4 temporary HP. Gain resistance to lightning damage for 1 elapsed hour(s), ending earlier with the parent feast.

**Duration:** Parent feast and its temporary HP end at the next completed beneficial Long Rest. Every rider also ends when this feast ends or is replaced. Its explicitly shorter deadline remains separate.

**Work:** Cookfire or Kitchen; Cook's utensils, Knife, Pot or pan. Mode field; field flag true; maximum assistants 0; formula required false.

**Exact ingredients:** 2 × Butter (component tier 2; 0.1 lb/unit; 8 gp/unit; seasoning; consumed); 1 × Water (component tier 2; 0.5 lb/unit; 8 gp/unit; solvent; consumed); 2 × Vegetables (component tier 2; 0.1 lb/unit; 8 gp/unit; substrate; consumed); 1 × sparkling petal (component tier 1; 0.36 lb/unit; 10 gp/unit; material; consumed).

**Food reservation:** 0.4 lb credited nutritive source inputs; up to 0 lb may return as the selected catalyst. For Standard quantity without catalyst retention, add 2.94 lb real ration-equivalent food. Before any completion check reserve 4.27 lb supplementary food for full Masterwork yield and worst legal nutritive catalyst retention. This is additional to every exact ingredient. Reservation does not consume food; after the outcome/catalyst choice and before finished servings are created, incorporate only the actual required amount. Generic failure without a finished product leaves all supplement unincorporated; a specific failed product spends only its required supplement. Actual food reference is 25 cp/lb, prorated from 5 sp per 2-lb daily ration; supplier quotes and transaction rounding still apply.

**Serving and storage:** each serving contains exactly 2/3 lb food and credits 1/3 Small/Medium daily food or 1/6 Large daily food after complete consumption. Before rolling, predeclare actual output dispositions for all 7 possible servings: real compatible storage capacity or distinct present recipients ready to begin immediate ten-minute consumption, one simultaneous slot per recipient. Immediate servings commit at batch completion; an invalid immediate slot needs actual reserved storage or cannot use the exception. Existing containers count only to their real capacity. A dedicated Meal Crock is 0.5 lb empty, 2 sp, 1 quart, AC 13/HP 2; one serving gives 7/6 lb gross. No water, fuel or full Supply is supplied by this food credit. Finished-food shelf life is 24 unprotected elapsed hours.

**Flawed:** {"mode": "half-batch-quantity", "quantity": 2}. Quality can change finite yield or dedicated mundane packaging durability; it does not improve meal potency. A dedicated Meal Crock first improved from maximum HP 2 to 3 gains exactly +1 current HP, preserving existing damage; an already-HP-3 crock gains neither again.

**Nutritional source map:** Butter counts as ordinary food; Water has no credited nutritive bulk in this card; Vegetables counts as ordinary food; sparkling petal has no credited nutritive bulk in this card.

## recipe-173 — Refined Verdant Tackle

**REVIEWED — authored operational PLAYTEST.** public; Fishing level 4; tier 2; Common; crafting DC 12; Standard quantity 4.

**Preserved source effect:** Grants +1 to Fishing checks. On a successful catch, gain 1 additional unit of usable meat or material; tagged bait preferentially attracts flora-aligned creatures.

**Operational effect:** On one eligible ordinary provision catch check, this actual participating Tackle offers +1 in equipment.leather-task-enhancement; choose the strongest independently eligible modifier once. It offers 1 in equipment.fishing-extra-recovery, separately compared at secure capture among sources that qualified at the check and still qualify. The first secure capture records one recovery evaluation for that physical creature, including zero; later recapture cannot raise it. Authorize only available disjoint real reserve units for later lawful harvesting, never immediate meat or extra creatures. Its one selectable attraction affinity is Flora; choose one source before one finite, weighted response allocation within 30 feet of connected water path. Local availability, perception, response and physical fit remain required. The three choices are independent; tags never combine automatically. The complete item must have positive structural HP, remain unsuppressed and unmelded, and actually participate in the registered method. It is reusable, but supplies no bait/chum or new opportunity. Neither case grants a separate activation, RP, concentration, charges, proficiency, AC candidate, resistance, food credit or bonus on harvesting, repair, research, creation or combat.

| Affinity | Intrinsic evidence (or explicit independently approved affinity) |
|---|---|
| Flora | Actual Plant creature type or explicitly botanical/fungal anatomy. |

| Complete body | gp | lb | HP / structural AC | Methods |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| 6 x 4 x 2-inch control board, winder, float, sinker and clips; no rod, line or hook | 1 | 1 | 5 / 15 | Rod |

**Assembly and use:** Mount the control board to the Rod or stable support so it actually controls the admitted line. Supply separate Rod, Line, Hook and bait/Lure. This output is not the 1 gp / 4 lb tool kit or a boat. All methods require actual prey/opportunity, access, receiving arrangements and the shared guide; maximum one unresolved deployment per lead.

**Attempt:** Five setup minutes, fifty fishing minutes, one WIS/Fishing check at minute 55, then five active retrieval minutes. Each active six seconds uses an Action and the actual required hands. ## recipe-92 — Refined Storm Roast

**Source:** public; Cooking level 3; tier 2; Common; DC 11; 1 active hours; 5 serving(s). Standard batch reference 69 gp.

**Preserved effect:** After a 10-minute meal, gain 4 temporary hit points and resistance to lightning damage for 1 hour. A creature can benefit from one feast at a time.

**Operational effect:** After completing and accepting this feast, offer 4 temporary HP. Gain resistance to lightning damage for 1 elapsed hour(s), ending earlier with the parent feast.

**Duration:** Parent feast and its temporary HP end at the next completed beneficial Long Rest. Every rider also ends when this feast ends or is replaced. Its explicitly shorter deadline remains separate.

**Work:** Cookfire or Kitchen; Cook's utensils, Knife, Pot or pan. Mode field; field flag true; maximum assistants 0; formula required false.

**Exact ingredients:** 2 × Butter (component tier 2; 0.1 lb/unit; 8 gp/unit; seasoning; consumed); 1 × Water (component tier 2; 0.5 lb/unit; 8 gp/unit; solvent; consumed); 2 × Vegetables (component tier 2; 0.1 lb/unit; 8 gp/unit; substrate; consumed); 1 × sparkling petal (component tier 1; 0.36 lb/unit; 10 gp/unit; material; consumed).

**Food reservation:** 0.4 lb credited nutritive source inputs; up to 0 lb may return as the selected catalyst. For Standard quantity without catalyst retention, add 2.94 lb real ration-equivalent food. Before any completion check reserve 4.27 lb supplementary food for full Masterwork yield and worst legal nutritive catalyst retention. This is additional to every exact ingredient. Reservation does not consume food; after the outcome/catalyst choice and before finished servings are created, incorporate only the actual required amount. Generic failure without a finished product leaves all supplement unincorporated; a specific failed product spends only its required supplement. Actual food reference is 25 cp/lb, prorated from 5 sp per 2-lb daily ration; supplier quotes and transaction rounding still apply.

**Serving and storage:** each serving contains exactly 2/3 lb food and credits 1/3 Small/Medium daily food or 1/6 Large daily food after complete consumption. Before rolling, predeclare actual output dispositions for all 7 possible servings: real compatible storage capacity or distinct present recipients ready to begin immediate ten-minute consumption, one simultaneous slot per recipient. Immediate servings commit at batch completion; an invalid immediate slot needs actual reserved storage or cannot use the exception. Existing containers count only to their real capacity. A dedicated Meal Crock is 0.5 lb empty, 2 sp, 1 quart, AC 13/HP 2; one serving gives 7/6 lb gross. No water, fuel or full Supply is supplied by this food credit. Finished-food shelf life is 24 unprotected elapsed hours.

**Flawed:** {"mode": "half-batch-quantity", "quantity": 2}. Quality can change finite yield or dedicated mundane packaging durability; it does not improve meal potency. A dedicated Meal Crock first improved from maximum HP 2 to 3 gains exactly +1 current HP, preserving existing damage; an already-HP-3 crock gains neither again.

**Nutritional source map:** Butter counts as ordinary food; Water has no credited nutritive bulk in this card; Vegetables counts as ordinary food; sparkling petal has no credited nutritive bulk in this card.

NEW allocation: order eligible categories by original occurrence; if more than one, roll uniform starting ordinal 1..N and distribute the one pool round-robin from there, respecting each actual anatomical cap and measured remaining mass. No eligible category means pool yields nothing. Record fixed unit IDs/allocation before worker choice; do not redirect forfeited quantities. One actual unit cannot belong to two categories. No exceptional additive drop is inferred here.
selectedComplete.selectionAndTime: Choose categories from the complete available manifest. Full time is this exact source time; partial time is ceil(fullMinutes*chosenCategories/availableCategories), minimum1minute. All unselected ordinary categories are forfeited when work begins. selectedComplete.workAndInterruption: NEW harvest-only physical progress completion: record actual exclusive active seconds of usable removal work; safe pauses retain only physically usable progress, clocks continue and real damage can destroy work/stock. selectedComplete.resolution: Core four-degree extraction check. Success recovers selected intact allocated units. selectedComplete.custodyAndAftermath: Award actual identified lots once at completion, with source occurrence, unit ID, quantity, weight, current condition, clock, owner/claimant and custodian kept separate. **Restriction:** Routine harvesting is culturally prohibited or legally restricted; samples require consent, lawful authority, or explicit dark-path play.

| Beast Hide (Tier 1) | 1 | 47%, 10 gp base |

Routine body harvesting is unlawful or culturally explosive. Equipment, venom, shed chitin, silk, and battlefield salvage are the safer sources of components.

selectedComplete.physicalTools: actual compatible removal tools, accessible stable remains and real containers; source skill training is not supplied by owning a kit

units.identityStatus: NEW source-local material unit; no global ingredient equivalence selected by matching label
units.unitDefinition: One identified finite physical source unit of the listed weight, requiring actual anatomy; fluid/bulk is measured, indivisible pieces cannot be synthesized from fractions. These weights/categories are NEW defaults, not recovered measurements.
units.rateInterpretation: One source-specific d100 availability test at original remains-manifest creation, success <= printed percent. This is eligibility within the one shared pool, not another pool or a second global-material roll.
units.quantity: Constrained share of one body-size pool fixed before category selection, actual anatomy/mass and prior losses. Unique actual organ/active core cap1 when its actual anatomy is one, not one per label/worker/fragment.
units.spoilBasis: Native source does not give a finer interval: explicitly selected local physical category uses the current framework conservative interval. Botanical samples use a NEW12h interval. Dry ordinary parts persist only while physically dry/intact. Active cores/specimens require a real compatible container to stop their clock.
units.clockOrigin: actual death or loss of sustaining environment; never harvesting, transfer, copying, splitting or reentry
units.conditionStages: Fresh until one unprotected interval; Degraded then half reference value and no Fresh recipe; Spoiled at two, value0/ordinary recipe unusable. Actual source preservation can pause age but not restore it.
units.publicKnowledge: Material qualities/access require actual identification and publication authorization. Mere source-local label does not grant edibility, compatibility, price, crafting effect, soul extraction or formula.

selectedComplete.identification: One minute actual close examination: native knowledge skill/INT, except Medicine/WIS; actual relevant proficiency only. One actually trained assistant+1 spends the same minute. Success exposes real recorded categories, hazards and clocks, not unobserved hidden sources. Failure no hidden qualities; plainly recognizable unidentified work may proceed at the actual disadvantage. No unchanged-evidence roll spam.
selectedComplete.extraction: The printed body-level skill/DC/time expressly governs removal for this source, overriding generic body time/DC; missing two use their labelled completion. It authorizes that actual skill as a removal route but grants neither training nor tools. A properly qualified actual gathering trade can supply its own genuine route. No double PB from skill plus tool. One eligible assistant+1 spends the entire extraction time.
selectedComplete.manifestAlgorithm: At actual remains availability, assign remainsId/bodyId/deathTime and all prior damage/custody/claims. Roll one size pool (Tiny1, Small1d2, Medium1d4, Large2d4,Huge4d4) under the accepted finite framework. Resolve each native category availability d100 once. NEW allocation: order eligible categories by original occurrence; if more than one, roll uniform starting ordinal 1..N and distribute the one pool round-robin from there, respecting each actual anatomical cap and measured remaining mass. No eligible category means pool yields nothing. Record fixed unit IDs/allocation before worker choice; do not redirect forfeited quantities. One actual unit cannot belong to two categories. No exceptional additive drop is inferred here.
selectedComplete.selectionAndTime: Choose categories from the complete available manifest. Full time is this exact source time; partial time is ceil(fullMinutes*chosenCategories/availableCategories), minimum1minute. All unselected ordinary categories are forfeited when work begins. Hurry halves that actual required time with upward minute rounding and disadvantage. No Craftsman/Spell Scribe research/manufacturing discount shortens harvest.
selectedComplete.workAndInterruption: NEW harvest-only physical progress completion: record actual exclusive active seconds of usable removal work; safe pauses retain only physically usable progress, clocks continue and real damage can destroy work/stock. No crafting incorporation stabilization or study-phase clock is imported. An interrupted unfinished attempt resumes the same selected finite units and original receipts, not a new yield roll. Completed failure exhausts that selected attempt. Another worker requires genuine access/skill and inherits existing physical progress, never duplicated hours or fresh material.
selectedComplete.resolution: Core four-degree extraction check. Success recovers selected intact allocated units. Critical success additionally saves at most one predeclared damaged/recoverable selected unit within the same anatomical cap; no nonexistent bonus. Failure ruins the highest-reference selected unit (actual tie choice recorded), recovers none, and exhausts selection. Critical failure ruins all selected units, with only actual declared hazard; absent one, real1d4 minor physical accident to lead. No new retry or repeated corpse conversion.
selectedComplete.custodyAndAftermath: Award actual identified lots once at completion, with source occurrence, unit ID, quantity, weight, current condition, clock, owner/claimant and custodian kept separate. Real carried gear is separate and not duplicated by harvest. Humanoid/celestial remains require actual consent/lawful authority/explicit dark-path source. A destroyed or Null-disabled living body is not automatically eligible remains. Magical projections, companions and Simulacra keep their own accepted no-farming/lifecycle procedures.
selectedComplete.noGuaranteedEquivalence: Every global material/recipe-name comparison is retained separately. A source-local unit is not that named catalog ingredient until actual properties/tier/form/amount/provenance satisfy the accepted exact card or a legitimate substitution record. Unresolved recipe labels remain unresolved references, not approved formulas or nonexistent history.
